onboarding.privacySummary: We use your details only to manage your appointments, treatments and billing at this clinic. We never sell your data. You can request a copy, correction or deletion of your data at any time from Settings.
onboarding.privacyFull: This clinic collects your name, contact details, and clinical records solely to provide and manage your care, appointments and billing. Your data is stored securely and shared only with clinic staff involved in your treatment, or as required by law. You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data, withdraw consent, or opt out of marketing communications at any time via Settings → Privacy & support. For questions, contact your clinic directly.
